items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: And then having Steve Allen, who loved this and was learning to play piano. And then I must say when Carson came aboard, he didn’t want me there. He wanted somebody else, because I was the house man.

ctx.x: And Bucky of course I knew from the Vaughan Monroe Orchestra. So it wasn’t me, I had a commitment to change the style of the orchestra and to do that, you know you have to start from scratch and I was so fortunate to have these type of players who still had enthusiasm for playing. And then one of my jobs was to do the service shows, The Today Show and The Tonight Show. I mean I did specials, but The Tonight Show, I was stuck in the pit for a long time. And then having Steve Allen, who loved this and was learning…
